scope: Native release Rust summary APIs on resident byte buffers. No disk/network/UI, SQL parsing or cross-worker transfer. Mixed-definition exception behavior excluded.
heap: Separate untimed allocation pass. Incremental live requested heap, not RSS; existing input/Definition allocations excluded. Cold reader includes copying Box input.
prior: Saved pre-generic-array summary source, rebuilt with the same current codec and registry as the optimized generic-array implementation.

methodology.input: Deterministic varied values generated inside the timed Rust SummaryAccumulator::ingest closure. Typed setters, cap/observation, event Pack load, and event Pack seal are timed. Encoded event Packs are retained, not immediately overwritten.
methodology.common_setup: DOC authoring and event Definition prescription are outside timing in both versions. Summary prescription is timed independently and included in total build.
methodology.cases: narrow: 1 numeric + category + bool, 1 day; typical: 8 numeric + category + bool, 7 days; wide: 32 numeric + category + bool, 7 days; quiet: typical shape, 1/24 periods active. Eight events per active period; every day retains all 288 summary rows.
methodology.validation: Each paired run has identical encoded-event SHA-256 and identical CBOR-serialized decoded-summary SHA-256, including every field in every period. Counts and category proofs asserted. Hashes also identical across repetitions. Full dashboard result JSON SHA-256 also matches in every pair.
methodology.zero_query: duration > 10000; generated duration values range 0–9000. All periods proven empty after sealing.
methodology.cold: Fresh SummaryReader over resident Box bytes, including owned input clone and first preview. Not OS disk-cache cold; template initialization occurred during ingestion.
methodology.warm: Ten actual preview evaluations on the same prepared reader, divided by ten. No cached result returned by the harness.
methodology.dashboard: One SummaryReport column collection plus ten finish() reductions; only duration metric. Not ten independent arbitrary SQL queries.
methodology.memory: Instrumentation disabled during timing; allocation metrics gathered in a separate pass. Requested allocation sizes, not allocator reserved memory or process RSS. Signed retained delta and peak additional live bytes exclude already-live input/source Definitions. initial-cache.json additionally measures shared schema initialization in a separate process, including the retained cache after dropping the first plan.
methodology.storage: Box byte count includes its catalog/footer and stored Packs. Current class library is larger; category counters shrink from 8 bytes to 3 and stored mode is removed. These numbers compare the entire current refactor, not array layout alone.
methodology.limits: No network, filesystem I/O, UI rendering, worker transfer or full query-planner dispatch measured. Ordinary single-shape days only; unresolved mixed-summary semantics are not exercised.
methodology.baseline: Prior summaries were rebuilt with the same optimized DOC/RX dependency as current summaries. Consequently these prior timings differ from the earlier frozen-binary report. Both received the codec setup improvements.
methodology.process: No test/build jobs were run alongside the final paired benchmark.
methodology.harness_change: The original harness was extended identically for both versions to hash the last complete dashboard result, outside timing. A separate environment-controlled mode measures initialization heap; normal timing mode is unchanged otherwise.

verification.wasm: Actual HTTP-ingested Pack fixtures passed live/recovered/hourly/daily/checkpoint queries and raw event reads
verification.deployment: Not deployed; mixed-summary exception policy remains outside this benchmark and unresolved.

remaining_cost: Narrow first-ever summary prescription is still slower (0.837 vs 0.571 ms); total narrow build is lower by 3.4%. Typical shared schema cache retains 907138 bytes once per process; per-plan heap excludes it and is reported separately.
